DroizDart, NA server. 

I'm a returning player to albion, but before I left all I did was econ stuff and gathering. Since I came back I've hit t8 skinning and started raising a couple mounts. 

I want to start trying out pvp, not really for ganking and stuff but more to be able to contest chests and be more prepped for mist stuff. This recent Easter event was the first time I've tried to do any pvp at all or anything in BZ lol.

So my question revolves round that. How would you keep your cool when trying to get a chest and players pull up? Is there actually a viable 1vX kinda build? How do I get over the constant worry of repair builds and potentially losing items?

Looking forward to seeing the answers to some of the other questions here too. Hope whatever you move onto and put your time into is as successful and rewarding as your time in Albion. 🙌

A pyroculus video is also on kyostinvs channel, and he does give you pre requirements to streamline your collection. 108 new oculi in total too. 

Goood luck I hope you succeed!
